## Description
Please summarize the changes made and the motivation behind them. If this addresses an open issue, link it here: `Fixes #...`

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New baseline algorithm or dataset integration
- [ ] Performance optimization (algorithmic or memory)
- [ ] Documentation or research artifact update (manuscript/figures)
- [ ] Other (please describe):

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the style guidelines of this project (`ruff check .` passes).
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand mathematical or algorithmic areas.
- [ ] I have verified that all unit tests pass locally (`python -m pytest tests -q`).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes.
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published in downstream modules.
